claim: The instruction admission/retirement harness enforces matched bounded evaluation and retires only directly receipted Hermes evaluator sessions after durable evidence capture.

smoke.interpretation: Expected bounded A/A smoke outcome: both identical artifacts hard-passed, judges produced no errors, and the run made no admission or retirement claim.

session_lifecycle.authority: runtime-issued session_id from each exact child stderr

coverage: representative, near-miss, adversarial, and held-out suite validation
matched baseline/candidate trials with order-swapped blind judging
bounded anytime-valid decision rule with explicit alpha, margin, trial, and run caps
normalized model, provider, reasoning, prompt assembly, context, and tool policy receipts
required-host no-regression aggregation and fail-closed missing-host behavior
success, nonzero failure, timeout, interruption, evidence-retention override, and report-before-cleanup lifecycle paths
rollback: Restore the prior tools/eval.py and tests/test_eval_gate.py, preserve the raw report, and do not promote any instruction mutation until the focused and live smoke gates pass again.
